verses.text: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan and the Canaanite kings along the coast heard Yahweh had dried up the Jordan so all Israel could cross. Their courage drained right out of them. 😟
Around then Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelite men again.’ 🪨
So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the Israelite men at Gibeath-haaraloth—the Hill of Foreskins. 🪨
Here’s why Joshua did it: all the men who left Egypt—all the fighting men—had died out in the wilderness along the way. 🏜️
Everyone who left Egypt had been circumcised. But the people born in the wilderness during the trip out of Egypt had not. 📜

Israel had wandered in the wilderness for forty years, until all the fighting men who left Egypt had died. They hadn’t listened to Yahweh, and he swore they wouldn’t see the land he promised their ancestors—a land flowing with milk and honey. 🏜️
Joshua circumcised the kids who had grown up in their place, because they hadn’t been circumcised on the journey. 👨‍👩‍👦
After the whole nation had been circumcised, they stayed in camp till they healed up. 🕊️
Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Today I’ve rolled Egypt’s shame away from you.’ That’s why the place is still called Gilgal. ✅
Israel camped at Gilgal and celebrated Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, out on Jericho’s plains. 🌙
The next day after Passover, they ate unleavened bread and roasted grain from the land’s harvest. 🌾
The day after they ate the land’s produce, the manna stopped. No more manna for Israel; that year they ate Canaan’s harvest. 🍞
When Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing there with a drawn sword. Joshua walked up and asked, ‘Are you with us or with our enemies?’ ⚔️
He answered, ‘Neither. I’ve come as commander of Yahweh’s army.’ Joshua dropped facedown and worshiped. Then he asked, ‘What does my lord have to say to his servant?’ 🙏
The commander of Yahweh’s army told Joshua, ‘Take off your sandals. The ground where you’re standing is holy.’ Joshua did exactly that. 🩴
